## WaterBench

The [DHI](https://www.dhigroup.com) WaterBench datasets are aimed at supporting educational, research, and exploratory activities, such as:

* Experimenting with water modeling using [MIKE Powered by DHI](https://www.dhigroup.com/technologies/mikepoweredbydhi).
* Validating hydrodynamic model outputs with observational data.
* Developing methods for automatically calibrating model parameters.
* Building data-driven models, including machine learning surrogates of the MIKE simulation results.

Each dataset is built around a realistic case and includes model setup files, input data, selected outputs, observations, and example notebooks for validation and analysis. Published on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org) and [GitHub](https://github.com/DHI) in a standardized structure, the datasets support reuse, reproducibility, education, and research.

### MIKESHE-Skjern {#mikeshe-skjern}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.18376532.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18376532) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKESHE-Skjern)

Integrated MIKE SHE hydrological model of Denmark's Skjern River catchment on a 500m grid covering 1990–2019. The model simulates evapotranspiration, overland flow, unsaturated zone, groundwater, and channel flow. Includes river discharge observations from gauges and groundwater depth measurements from wells for validation.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKESHE-Skjern/main/figures/station_location.png)

> DHI, GEUS (2026). Integrated Hydrological Model of Skjern Å catchment: MIKE SHE model setup, inputs, outputs and observation data [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18376532](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18376532)

### MIKE21HD-SouthernNorthSea {#mike21hd-southernnorthsea}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.14929387.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14929387) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-SouthernNorthSea)

Simplified MIKE 21 HD model of the Southern North Sea with ~8,000 elements (reduced from 150,000), covering the English Channel through the coasts of England, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, and Denmark for 2022–2023. Based on DHI's work for the IJmuiden Ver offshore wind farm zone. Validated against in-situ measurements and satellite altimetry.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-SouthernNorthSea/main/figures/geometry.png)

> DHI. (2025). Hydrodynamic model of the Southern North Sea: MIKE21 model setup, outputs and observation data (Version v1) [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14929387](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14929387)

---

### MIKE21SW-SouthernNorthSea {#mike21sw-southernnorthsea}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.17413569.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17413569) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21SW-SouthernNorthSea)

Spectral wave model companion to the HD Southern North Sea case, covering the same domain for 2022–2023. The simplified mesh uses coarser inputs from ERA5 wind/pressure data and DHI's global wave model for boundary conditions. Validated against CMEMS buoy measurements and satellite altimetry from multiple missions.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21SW-SouthernNorthSea/main/figures/geometry.png)

> DHI. (2025). Spectral wave model of the Southern North Sea: MIKE21 SW model setup, outputs and observation data [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17413569](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17413569)

### MIKE21HD-ConceptionBay {#mike21hd-conceptionbay}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.14504931.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14504931) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-ConceptionBay)

MIKE 21 HD model of Conception Bay, Newfoundland, Canada with 8,474 elements covering ~900 km² for 2014–2022. Uses ERA5 reanalysis forcing and Canadian Hydrographic Service bathymetry. Validated against local measurement stations and satellite altimetry.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-ConceptionBay/main/figures/geometry.png)

> DHI. (2024). Hydrodynamic model of Conception Bay: MIKE21 model setup, outputs and observation data [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14504931](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14504931)

---

### MIKE21HD-Oresund {#mike21hd-oresund}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.14160710.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14160710) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-Oresund)

MIKE 21 HD model of the Øresund strait between Denmark and Sweden with 3,320 elements covering ~2,000 km² for 2014–2023. Uses ERA5 meteorological forcing and DHI's DKBS model for boundary conditions. Validated against Copernicus and SMHI observations as well as satellite altimetry from six missions.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DHI/WaterBench-MIKE21HD-Oresund/main/figures/geometry.png)

> DHI. (2024). Hydrodynamic model of Øresund: MIKE21 model setup, outputs and observation data (1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14160710](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14160710)

### TimeSeries-WWTPInflow {#timeseries-wwtpinflow}

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.15301164.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15301164) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DHI/WaterBench-TimeSeries-WWTPINflow)

Approximately 15 months of hourly measurements of combined sewage inflow to an anonymized Danish wastewater treatment plant, accompanied by meteorological variables (precipitation, pressure, radiation, humidity, air and soil temperatures) from DMI. Intended for investigating data-driven inflow forecasting and benchmarking machine learning models.

> DHI. (2025). Inflow to a Waste Water Treatment Plant: observations and processed data [Data set]. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15301164](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15301164)

## Related datasets and benchmarks

Other open datasets and benchmark collections that may be of interest:

| Dataset | Domain | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| [Bellinge](https://data.dtu.dk/collections/Dataset_for_Bellinge_An_urban_drainage_case_study/5029124) | Urban drainage | Urban drainage case study for Bellinge, Denmark, widely used for benchmarking urban drainage models. |
| [Caravan](https://github.com/kratzert/Caravan) | Hydrology | Open community dataset of meteorological forcing data, catchment attributes, and discharge data for catchments around the world. |
| [CAMELS](https://doi.org/10.5065/D6G73C3Q) | Hydrology | Catchment Attributes and Meteorology for Large-sample Studies — hydrometeorological time series and catchment attributes for 671 basins in the contiguous United States. |
| [OceanBench](https://github.com/jejjohnson/oceanbench) | Oceanography | Framework for benchmarking machine learning models on ocean tasks such as sea surface height interpolation, with standardized processing compliant with domain-expert standards. |
| [PDEBench](https://github.com/pdebench/PDEBench) | Scientific ML | Extensive benchmark for scientific machine learning providing datasets and baseline models for training neural networks to solve partial differential equations. |
| [RealPDEBench](https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/RealPDEBench) | Scientific ML | Benchmark with paired real-world measurements and matched numerical simulations for complex physical systems, targeting spatiotemporal forecasting and sim-to-real transfer. |

## Data providers

Large-scale open data providers relevant to water, ocean, atmosphere, and geoscience modelling:

| Provider | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Copernicus Marine Service](https://marine.copernicus.eu) | Ocean observations, reanalyses, and forecasts for the global ocean and European seas. |
| [Copernicus Climate Data Store](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu) | ERA5 reanalysis, seasonal forecasts, climate projections, and satellite-derived climate variables. |
| [NOAA Open Data](https://www.noaa.gov/information-technology/open-data-dissemination) | US weather, ocean, and climate data including tides, currents, bathymetry, and atmospheric observations. |
| [dynamical.org](https://dynamical.org) | Easy-access catalog of archived weather datasets and forecasts in analysis-ready formats. |
| [EMODnet](https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu) | European marine observation data covering bathymetry, geology, physics, chemistry, and biology. |
| [USGS Water Data](https://waterdata.usgs.gov) | Real-time and historical streamflow, groundwater, and water quality data for the United States. |
| [USGS Water Mission Area Catalog](https://water.usgs.gov/catalog/datasets/) | Integrated datasets and tools from the USGS Water Mission Area for water-related research. |
| [World Ocean Database (NOAA)](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/world-ocean-database) | World's largest collection of uniformly formatted, quality-controlled ocean profile data from the 1770s to present. |
| [OpenET](https://etdata.org) | Open-source evapotranspiration data for water management across the western United States. |
| [UC Davis Hydrology Datasets](https://guides.library.ucdavis.edu/hydrology/datasets) | Curated guide to hydrological datasets and data repositories for research. |
